digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and banking system
propositions: Step budget defaults are too low (8/48) and clamp too restrictive (480), causing legitimate multi-AC epic validation to exhaust and fail incorrectly; raise to 24/160 with 960 clamp and add evidence-surface scaling term (child traversal + fixed overhead inside verify_step_floor)

Budget sizing omits the cost of traversing child tickets in epics (5-10 requests per child); add a direct_children parameter to verify_step_floor formula shared by both primary sizing (completion.py:780) and plan_recovery_pool (completion_banking.py:224)

Repeated re-verification re-proves all criteria (~10 min/cycle) with no carryover; implement cross-run PASS-verdict cache scoped by criterion-text hash and content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths) to seed validated verdicts into re-runs, seeded records bypass finalizer downgrade and omit re-verification

Cached PASS verdicts must be invalidated correctly when file_impact content changes (blob SHA rotation) or criterion text changes, but persist across unrelated commits and ref-targeted verification by binding fingerprints to the verified-at ref

Seeded cache entries must integrate with banking without duplication: primary_criteria_manifest omits seeded IDs, primary context marks them "already credited", and merge_finalizer_with_bank preserves seeded records verbatim against finalizer echoes
